title: In braille, inserted words that appear above the print line are enclosed in parentheses and placed after the corresponding material in the sentence.

illustrates.quote: In braille, inserted words that appear above the print line are enclosed in parentheses and placed after the corresponding material in the sentence.

resolution: Both runs already agreed byte-for-byte on this file (wording, textLines, and illustrates.rule) — confirmed directly against the source at the given textLines. Unlike the §19 gold precedent (where both runs shared a single hard-set placeholder rule id on all six embedded quotes), both runs here already correctly set illustrates.rule to this quote's own citing rule (18.6.4e), matching the source exactly; no placeholder-id bug recurs in §18.
